name: The ButterFly Effect
source:
Jaden Manro is a popular high school junior. He's  super smart, athletic, and has all the girls falling for him. After his parents' death though, all his wants is to be left alone. Between his childhood friend, Monica; her best friend Crystal; his fan girl Sabri;  and the new girl Heaven; He may never get the alone time he wants. Play as Jaden in this Slice of Life/Romance with multiple ending. Will you end up with your favorite girl? Or will you give Jaden the alone time he want by pushing others away? The choice is yours, but remember, each choice changes a life.

(This game is meant for a mature audience. It contains sensitive subjects such as Abuse, Racism, Depression, Suicide, ect. Player discretion advised.)

[From [url=https://therealssjmike.itch.io/butterfly-effect]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
贾登·曼罗 (Jaden Manro) 是一名受欢迎的高中生。他非常聪明，运动能力强，让所有女孩都为他倾倒。然而，在父母去世后，他只想一个人呆着。在他儿时的朋友莫妮卡之间；她最好的朋友克里斯托；他的迷妹萨布里；还有新来的女孩天堂；他可能永远得不到他想要的独处时间。在这部具有多重结局的人生片段/浪漫故事中扮演贾登。最后你会和你最喜欢的女孩在一起吗？或者你会推开其他人，给贾登他想要的独处时间吗？选择权在你，但请记住，每一个选择都会改变你的生活。

（该游戏适合成熟观众。其中包含敏感主题，例如虐待、种族主义、抑郁、自杀等。建议玩家自行决定。）

[来自[url=https://therealssjmike.itch.io/butterfly-effect]Itch.io[/url]]
